cases.historical_behavior: Before openai/codex #10207, CODEX_HOME could be rediscovered and loaded as a project .codex layer, duplicating the same config source.
cases.current_behavior: Since commit dd6c1d3787aa3c8032f6e6496e2bf25c47ddb37a, project-layer traversal skips CODEX_HOME using absolute and best-effort canonical path identity.
cases.why_regression_case: A resolver that double-loads CODEX_HOME can change precedence, trust warnings, and provenance.

cases.historical_behavior: codex-cli 0.144.6 reproduction in openai/codex #34193 showed one canonical AGENTS.md contributing once as global instructions and again as project instructions.
cases.current_behavior: The issue remains open and current source at 94174e44cbc54cece45f6052328ca0c2cd7a8a2a still assembles user instructions separately from project-discovered entries without cross-source canonical-path deduplication.
cases.why_regression_case: Codex Scope must track current implementation parity without treating the duplication as desired semantics; an upstream fix should intentionally flip this fixture.

cases.historical_behavior: Older Codex profile selection used legacy profile tables in config.toml.
cases.current_behavior: Official documentation states that as of Codex 0.134.0, --profile selects a separate CODEX_HOME/<name>.config.toml file and no longer reads the legacy [profiles.<name>] table.
cases.why_regression_case: Reintroducing legacy table selection would silently change the effective layer stack and violate the current profile-v2 boundary.

cases.historical_behavior: The legacy approval_policy="untrusted" value existed in older Codex semantics and Codex Scope previously classified it as supported.
cases.current_behavior: Current official Codex documentation says approval_policy="untrusted" is no longer supported; trust is configured separately.
cases.why_regression_case: Continuing to report the historical value as resolved current semantics is false certainty and can mislead compatibility checks.

cases.historical_behavior: Before openai/codex commit 85e0661c3baacc62db7b006d2b8085b006d0795e, project_doc_max_bytes was applied independently to each selected environment, so total project instruction bytes could grow by one full budget per environment.
cases.current_behavior: Since commit 85e0661c3baacc62db7b006d2b8085b006d0795e, project_doc_max_bytes is one aggregate budget consumed in selected-environment order; the entry reaching the remaining limit is truncated and later environments are skipped once the budget is exhausted.
cases.why_regression_case: Per-environment budgeting can exceed the current aggregate safety/semantic boundary. Codex Scope's local cumulative-byte fixture remains compatible for one environment, while multi-environment composition stays explicitly outside the supported deterministic resolver boundary.
